name: Bali
overview: Rice terraces, cliffside temples, and a coastline split between surf towns and quiet fishing villages — Bali remains Southeast Asia's most complete island trip.
travelTips: Rent a scooter for Ubud's backroads
Carry small rupiah notes for temple donations
Book Nusa Penida boats a day ahead
safety: Generally safe; watch for strong currents on southern beaches and monkey theft near temples.

faqs.question: How many days do I need in Bali?
faqs.answer: 5–7 days covers Ubud, the southern beaches, and one nearby island like Nusa Penida comfortably.

faqs.question: Is Bali good for a first-time visit to Southeast Asia?
faqs.answer: Yes — infrastructure is easy, English is widely spoken, and the island suits both relaxed and adventurous itineraries.

name: Paris
overview: The Seine, wide boulevards, and centuries of art packed into walkable arrondissements — Paris rewards travelers who slow down and linger in cafés as much as museums.
travelTips: Buy a Navigo Easy card for the metro
Most museums are free on first Sundays off-season
Book the Eiffel Tower online in advance
safety: Generally safe; stay alert for pickpockets around major landmarks and the metro.

faqs.question: Is Paris walkable?
faqs.answer: Central Paris is extremely walkable, and the metro covers everything else efficiently.

faqs.question: What's the best time to visit?
faqs.answer: Late spring and early autumn bring mild weather and thinner crowds than summer.

name: Dubai
overview: Desert dunes give way to the world's tallest tower — Dubai mixes souks, superyacht marinas, and record-chasing architecture into a compact, easy-to-navigate city.
travelTips: Dress modestly in Old Dubai and religious sites
Metro is the cheapest way between districts
Book desert safaris a day ahead in peak season
safety: Very safe with low crime rates; heat exhaustion is the main risk in summer months.

faqs.question: Is Dubai expensive?
faqs.answer: It can be, but budget hotels, the metro, and food courts make a mid-range trip very doable.

faqs.question: Best time to visit Dubai?
faqs.answer: November through March avoids the extreme summer heat and humidity.

name: Zermatt
overview: A car-free village beneath the Matterhorn, reached by cogwheel train, with glacier skiing in winter and alpine trails once the snow clears.
travelTips: Zermatt is car-free — arrive by train from Täsch
Book Matterhorn glacier lift tickets online
Pack layers even in summer
safety: Very safe; follow marked trails and check weather before high-altitude hikes.

faqs.question: Do I need a car in Zermatt?
faqs.answer: No — the village is car-free. Park in Täsch and take the shuttle train in.

faqs.question: Can I see the Matterhorn without hiking?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Gornergrat and Klein Matterhorn cable cars both give close-up views.

name: Tokyo
overview: Ancient shrines sit blocks from neon crossings — Tokyo runs on precise trains and rewards travelers who wander into its smaller neighborhoods.
travelTips: Get a Suica/Pasmo card for trains
Convenience stores (konbini) are excellent for cheap meals
Cash is still king outside major chains
safety: Extremely safe, even late at night; standard city awareness still applies.

faqs.question: Is Tokyo expensive?
faqs.answer: It can match Western Europe prices, but konbini food, trains, and free shrines keep budget travel realistic.

faqs.question: Do I need to speak Japanese?
faqs.answer: No — signage in major areas is bilingual and translation apps cover the rest.

name: Phuket
overview: Thailand's largest island pairs limestone karst boat trips with a lively beach-town nightlife scene and some of the country's best seafood.
travelTips: Negotiate tuk-tuk fares before boarding
Rainy season (June–October) still has sunny mornings
Book Phi Phi tours to leave before 8am for fewer crowds
safety: Generally safe; use licensed taxis and be cautious with rented scooters.

faqs.question: Phuket or Bali for a beach trip?
faqs.answer: Phuket suits island-hopping and nightlife; Bali suits a mix of culture, surf, and wellness.

faqs.question: Is Phuket good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes — many resort areas have calm bays and family-oriented activities.

name: Singapore
overview: Hawker centers, rainforest-covered towers, and one of the world's most efficient transit systems make Singapore an easy, endlessly photogenic stopover or standalone trip.
travelTips: EZ-Link card covers MRT and buses
Chewing gum import is restricted
Hawker centers offer the best value meals
safety: Among the safest cities in the world; strict laws are enforced.

faqs.question: Is 3 days enough for Singapore?
faqs.answer: Yes — 3–4 days covers Marina Bay, Sentosa, and the hawker/heritage districts comfortably.

name: Maldives
overview: Overwater villas, private lagoons, and some of the world's clearest reef diving — the Maldives is built for slow, disconnected relaxation.
travelTips: Book resort transfers (speedboat/seaplane) in advance
Alcohol is limited to resort islands
Reef shoes help on house reefs
safety: Very safe; the main risks are sun exposure and reef currents.

faqs.question: Is the Maldives good for a honeymoon?
faqs.answer: It's one of the most popular honeymoon destinations worldwide, especially overwater villa resorts.

name: London
overview: Free world-class museums, riverside walks, and neighborhoods that shift character block by block — London rewards travelers who explore beyond zone 1.
travelTips: Get an Oyster card for the Tube
Most major museums are free
Book West End tickets midweek for better prices
safety: Generally safe; standard precautions around crowded tourist areas.

faqs.question: How many days for London?
faqs.answer: 4–6 days lets you cover central sights plus at least one day trip.

name: New York
overview: Five boroughs of world-class museums, food from every corner of the planet, and skyline views that change with every bridge you cross.
travelTips: Get a MetroCard/OMNY for the subway
Book major attraction tickets online in advance
Broadway lottery apps offer discounted seats
safety: Generally safe in tourist areas; stay aware on late-night subway rides.

faqs.question: Best time to visit NYC?
faqs.answer: Spring and fall bring mild weather; December adds holiday lights but heavier crowds.

name: Jaipur, Rajasthan
overview: The Pink City — a living museum of Rajput palaces, bazaars, and hilltop forts, founded in 1727 on Vedic city-planning principles.
thingsToDo: Bazaar shopping for jewelry and textiles
Rooftop dinner overlooking the old city
travelTips: Agree taxi fares upfront
Cover shoulders and knees at temples
Carry cash for smaller bazaars
safety: Generally safe; watch for overpricing near major forts.

faqs.question: How many days do I need in Jaipur?
faqs.answer: 3–4 days is enough to cover the major forts, palaces, and bazaars comfortably.

name: Rishikesh, Uttarakhand
overview: The self-declared yoga capital of the world, set where the Ganges rushes out of the Himalayan foothills — equal parts ashram town and whitewater rafting base.
travelTips: Alcohol and meat are restricted in much of town
Book rafting through registered operators
Carry a shawl for evening river winds
safety: Generally safe; follow guide instructions on rafting and river currents.

faqs.question: Is Rishikesh good for beginners at rafting?
faqs.answer: Yes, Grade II–III stretches are beginner-friendly with licensed operators.

name: Alleppey, Kerala
overview: The Venice of the East — a maze of backwater canals best explored on an overnight houseboat, drifting past coconut groves and paddy fields.
travelTips: Book houseboats with a certified operator
July–August brings the snake boat races
Pack light cottons and mosquito repellent
safety: Generally safe; verify houseboat safety equipment before boarding.

faqs.question: Is one night on a houseboat enough?
faqs.answer: Yes — most houseboat cruises run a scenic afternoon-to-morning loop that covers the highlights.

name: Goa
overview: Portuguese-era churches, spice-scented markets, and a coastline that swings from party beaches in the north to quiet coves in the south.
travelTips: Rent a scooter for coastal roads
North Goa is livelier, South Goa is quieter
Book beach shacks ahead during Christmas week
safety: Generally safe; watch valuables on crowded beaches and swim within flagged zones.

faqs.question: North or South Goa?
faqs.answer: North Goa suits nightlife and markets; South Goa suits quiet beaches and resorts.

name: Manali, Himachal Pradesh
overview: A pine-covered valley town in the Himalayan foothills, gateway to Rohtang Pass and the trekking routes into Spiti and Ladakh.
travelTips: Rohtang Pass requires a permit in peak season
Pack warm layers even in summer
Book paragliding with certified operators
safety: Generally safe; check road conditions before high-altitude drives.

faqs.question: Is Manali good in winter?
faqs.answer: Yes — snow activities peak from December to February, though some passes close.
